title: Classify the Chain
description:
Amaka has the full list of vulnerabilities confirmed during the investigation. The classifications are not in dispute — every option below names the same four findings with the same CWEs. What legal needs is the ORDER they were exploited in, because the kill-chain sequence drives the remediation priority and the incident narrative.

Reconstruct the chain from what you actually did across this stage: the login (task 3), the search field (task 4), the notes feature (task 5), the import feature (task 6). Pick the option that lists every class in the correct order of exploitation.

Reference: OWASP Top 10 2021 A03 Injection (CWE-89, CWE-79), A01 Broken Access Control, A10 Server-Side Request Forgery (CWE-918).

choices: SQL injection (login form, CWE-89) → reflected cross-site scripting (search field, CWE-79) → stored cross-site scripting (notes feature, CWE-79 stored variant) → server-side request forgery (import feature, CWE-918)
